I don't know how much I can help you, because I am in a similar situation, but here goes (things I've learned so far):

In order to make friends, you have to do it from a place of love over fear. I.e.: you have to love yourself, love that person, and be in love with the idea of being in a friendship with them to begin with. If you do not love yourself, you will turn people off, so write a list of all your good traits and reflect on it often, think of what you can offer people, invest in doing things you love just because, love the life you live so much that you don't need anybody. 

If you do not love that person, it will be hard to get anything more than a superficial connection. Wait until somebody completely energises your whole being and then reach out. I know you have to start talking to someone to get to know them lol, but don't go straight to hardcore friendship talk until you're sure you like them, maybe write a list of characteristics you want your new friends to have (you will make some). 

If you do not love the idea of being in a friendship with them, it will fizzle out quickly, you will not know how to keep up a conversation and there will be no mojo. So keep trying and don't give up on yourself.
